frame_size_calculation.description: Frame size = Payload + Ethernet overhead (38 bytes: 18 header + 20 IFG)

CBS_parameters_per_port.description: For each egress port, CBS parameters are calculated based on flows traversing that port
CBS_parameters_per_port.note: Assuming max frame size for lower priority traffic = 1500 bytes payload + 38 overhead = 1538 bytes

per_hop_delay.formula: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_M6^h, beta_M6^h) = sup_{t>=0} { inf { tau >= 0 : alpha_M6^h(t) <= beta_M6^h(t + tau) } }
per_hop_delay.b_M6_h: sum of all burst sizes of flows in class M6 at port h

end_to_end_WCD.formula: WCD_f = sum(D_f^h for all hops h) + hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay)

all_parameters_used.aggregate_burst_calculation: sum of frame sizes of all flows at port

steps: 1. Calculate frame size for each flow: payload + 38 bytes overhead
2. Calculate arrival curve parameters: b = frame_size, rho = frame_size / period
3. For each egress port, identify all flows traversing it
4. Calculate aggregate burst at each port: sum of frame sizes
5. Calculate CBS credit bounds: c_min = sendSlope * l_max / C, c_max = 0
6. Calculate service curve latency: T = c_max / idleSlope
7. Calculate per-hop delay: D = (aggregate_burst + c_max) / idleSlope
8. Calculate serialization delay per hop: frame_size * 8 / bandwidth
9. Sum all delays: queueing + propagation + switching + serialization
equations_used: D_f^h = (sum(l_f for all flows at port) + c_max) / idleSlope

equations_used.arrival_curve_at_source: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f^h0 + rho_f^h0 * t, where b_f^h0 = l_f (frame_size in bits), rho_f^h0 = l_f / P_f
equations_used.aggregate_arrival_curve: alpha_{M_i}^h(t) = sum over all flows in class M_i of min(alpha_f^{h-,h}(t), sigma_link^{h-,h}(t), sigma_{CBS}^{h-,h}(t))
equations_used.credit_upper_bound: c_{M_i}^{h,max} = idleSlope_{M_i}^h * (sum_{j<i} c_{M_j}^{h,min} - l_{>i}^{h,max}) / (sum_{j<i} idleSlope_{M_j}^h - C)
equations_used.per_hop_delay: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_{M_i}^h, beta_{M_i}^h) = sup_{t>=0} { inf { tau >= 0 : alpha_{M_i}^h(t) <= beta_{M_i}^h(t + tau) } }
equations_used.end_to_end_wcd: WCD_f = sum(D_f^h for all hops h) + hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay)

cbs_parameters_per_port.description: All ports use same CBS parameters since all flows are AVB Class A with PCP 6

all_parameters_used.aggregate_burst_estimation: Sum of all flow bursts traversing the port

equations_used.arrival_curve_at_source: alpha_f^h0(t) = l_f + (l_f / P_f) * t, where l_f = payload + 38 bytes overhead, P_f = period in seconds
equations_used.aggregate_arrival_curve: alpha_{M_i}^h(t) = sum over all flows in class M_i of min(alpha_f^{h-,h}(t), sigma_link^{h-,h}(t), sigma_{CBS}^{h-,h}(t))
equations_used.per_hop_delay: D_h = hDev(alpha_aggregate^h, beta^h) = sup_{t>=0} inf{tau >= 0: alpha(t) <= beta(t+tau)}
equations_used.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum(D_h for all hops) + hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay)

CBS_parameters_per_port.description: All ports use same CBS parameters since all flows are AVB Class A

per_hop_delay_calculation.formula: D = hDev(alpha_aggregate, beta) where alpha is aggregate arrival curve and beta is CBS service curve
per_hop_delay_calculation.approximation: For rate-latency service curve beta(t) = R*(t-T), delay D ≈ burst/rate + latency = (aggregate_burst / idleSlope) + (c_max / idleSlope)
per_hop_delay_calculation.aggregate_burst: sum of all flow bursts (frame sizes) traversing the port

all_parameters_used.service_curve: beta(t) = 75 Mbps * t (rate-latency with zero latency term since c_max=0)

WCD_calculation.detailed_calculation: At each egress port h, compute aggregate arrival curve alpha_M_i^h(t) = sum of all flows' arrival curves shaped by link and CBS. Link shaping: sigma_link(t) = C*t + l_max. CBS shaping: sigma_CBS(t) = idleSlope*t + (c_max - c_min) + l_max. c_min = sendSlope * l_max / C. c_max = 0 (no higher priority). Service curve: beta(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+. Delay D = hDev(alpha, beta) = sup_t inf{tau: alpha(t) <= beta(t+tau)}. For single flow or light aggregate, D ≈ (b + c_max)/idleSlope + l_max/C. WCD = sum(D_h) + 4*(1+1) + 1.

global_parameters.no_higher_priority_classes: true (all flows use same priority, so c_max = 0)

equations_used.service_curve: beta(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+ = 75 Mbps * t (since c_max=0)

frame_overhead.note: Frame size on wire = payload + overhead

equations_used.arrival_curve_at_source: alpha_f^h0(t) = l_f + (l_f / P_f) * t, where l_f is frame size (payload + overhead in bytes), P_f is period in seconds
equations_used.arrival_curve_propagation: alpha_f^h(t) = alpha_f^(h-1) deconvolved with delta_{D_f^(h-1)}(t), where D_f^(h-1) is latency at previous hop
equations_used.aggregate_arrival_curve: alpha_{M_i}^h(t) = sum over all flows in class M_i of min(alpha_f^h(t), sigma_link^h(t), sigma_CBS^h(t))
equations_used.link_shaping_curve: sigma_link^h(t) = C*t + l_max, where C = 100 Mbps, l_max is max frame size
equations_used.credit_lower_bound: c_min = sendSlope * l_max / C = -25 Mbps * l_max / 100 Mbps = -0.25 * l_max
equations_used.credit_upper_bound: c_max = 0 (no higher priority classes than AVB_A at PCP 6)
equations_used.cbs_service_curve: beta^h(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+ = 75 Mbps * [t - 0]^+ = 75 Mbps * t
equations_used.per_hop_delay: D^h = hDev(alpha^h, beta^h) = sup_{t>=0} { inf { tau >= 0 : alpha^h(t) <= beta^h(t + tau) } }
equations_used.end_to_end_wcd: WCD_f = sum(D_f^h for all hops h) + hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay)

all_parameters_used.frame_overhead: 42 bytes (preamble 8 + IFG 12 + Ethernet header 14 + VLAN 4 + FCS 4)
all_parameters_used.aggregate_burst_per_port: sum of all flow bursts traversing that port

frame_sizes.description: Frame size = Payload + Ethernet overhead (38 bytes: 18 header + 20 IFG)

arrival_curves.description: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f^h0 + rho_f^h0 * t, where b_f^h0 = l_f (frame size in bits), rho_f^h0 = l_f / P_f (bits/us)

cbs_parameters_per_port.description: CBS parameters computed per egress port. c_min = sendSlope * l_max / C, c_max = 0 (no higher priority class), service curve beta(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+

WCD_calculation.description: WCD_f = sum of per-hop delays + (hop_count * propagation_delay) + (hop_count * switching_delay). Per-hop delay D_f^h = hDev(alpha_M^h, beta_M^h) computed using horizontal deviation between aggregate arrival curve and CBS service curve at each port.
WCD_calculation.equation: D_f^h = sup_{t>=0} { inf { tau >= 0 : alpha_M^h(t) <= beta_M^h(t + tau) } }
WCD_calculation.per_hop_components: propagation_delay = 1 us, switching_delay = 1 us per hop

arrival_curve_parameters.description: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f^h0 + rho_f^h0 * t, where b_f^h0 = l_f (frame size in bits), rho_f^h0 = l_f / P_f (bits per us)

cbs_parameters_per_port.description: CBS parameters computed per egress port for AVB class A (queue 6)

per_hop_delay_calculation.description: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_{M_i}^h, beta_{M_i}^h) = sup_{t>=0} { inf { tau >= 0 : alpha_{M_i}^h(t) <= beta_{M_i}^h(t + tau) } }
per_hop_delay_calculation.method: Aggregate all flows at each port, compute horizontal deviation between aggregate arrival curve and CBS service curve
per_hop_delay_calculation.aggregate_arrival: alpha_{M_i}^h(t) = sum of all flow arrivals shaped by link and CBS curves
per_hop_delay_calculation.service_curve: beta_{M_i}^h(t) = idleSlope * [t - theta]^+, where theta = c_max / idleSlope

end_to_end_WCD_calculation.description: WCD_f = sum of (D_f^h + propagation_delay + switching_delay) over all hops in path
end_to_end_WCD_calculation.equation: WCD_f = sum_{h in path} D_f^h + (hop_count * 2 us)

all_parameters_used.horizontal_deviation: hDev computed as sup-inf for aggregate arrival vs service curve

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD_f = sum_{h in path} [D_f^h + propagation_delay_h + switching_delay_h]
WCD_calculation.D_f^h_computation: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_{aggregate}^h, beta^h) where alpha_{aggregate}^h includes all flows at port h shaped by link and CBS curves
WCD_calculation.simplification: For each egress port, compute aggregate arrival curve, apply CBS service curve, compute horizontal deviation
WCD_calculation.overhead_per_hop: propagation_delay (1 us) + switching_delay (1 us) = 2 us per hop (except last hop to end system)

frame_overhead.note: Frame size on wire = payload + overhead

equations_used.arrival_curve: alpha_f^h0(t) = b_f^h0 + rho_f^h0 * t, where b_f^h0 = l_f (frame size), rho_f^h0 = l_f / P_f
equations_used.credit_upper_bound: c_{M_i}^{h,max} = 0 (no higher priority classes than AVB_A at PCP=6)
equations_used.per_hop_delay: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_{M_i}^h, beta_{M_i}^h) = sup_{t>=0} { inf { tau >= 0 : alpha_{M_i}^h(t) <= beta_{M_i}^h(t + tau) } }
equations_used.end_to_end_wcd: WCD_f = sum of D_f^h over all hops + (hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay))

cbs_parameters_per_port.note: All ports use same CBS parameters since all flows are AVB Class A, PCP=6
cbs_parameters_per_port.c_min_calculation: c_min = sendSlope * l_max / C = -25000000 * l_max / 100000000 = -0.25 * l_max

per_hop_delay_calculation.aggregate_burst: Sum of all frame sizes traversing the port in the same class

cbs_parameters_derivation.note_on_credit_upper: Since all flows are AVB Class A (no higher priority class j<i exists), and assuming no lower priority traffic (l_{>i}^{h,max}=0), c_{M_i}^{h,max} = 0

arrival_curve_construction.burst_b_f: l_f (frame size on wire including overhead)

aggregate_arrival_curve.formula: alpha_{M_i}^h(t) = sum over incoming ports h- and flows f in class M_i of [alpha_{M_i}^{h-,h}(t) AND link-shaping-curve AND CBS-shaping-curve]
aggregate_arrival_curve.note: The effective arrival curve at each hop is shaped by both link capacity and CBS shaper

per_hop_delay_calculation.formula: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_{M_i}^h, beta_{M_i}^h) = sup_{t>=0} { inf { tau >= 0 : alpha_{M_i}^h(t) <= beta_{M_i}^h(t + tau) } }
per_hop_delay_calculation.method: Network Calculus Total Flow Analysis - horizontal deviation between aggregate arrival curve and service curve
per_hop_delay_calculation.note: All flows in AVB Class A share the same per-hop delay at each port

end_to_end_wcd_calculation.formula: WCD_f = sum(D_f^h for all hops h) + hop_count * propagation_delay + hop_count * switching_delay

all_parameters_used.time_sync_error: 1 us (not directly used in WCD calculation)

all_parameters_used.credit_upper_bound: 0 bits (no higher priority traffic, no lower priority traffic)
all_parameters_used.credit_lower_bound: sendSlope * l_max / C for each port

WCD_calculation.per_hop_delay: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_{M_i}^h, beta_{M_i}^h) where alpha is aggregate arrival curve and beta is CBS service curve
WCD_calculation.horizontal_deviation: sup_{t>=0} { inf { tau >= 0 : alpha_{M_i}^h(t) <= beta_{M_i}^h(t + tau) } }
WCD_calculation.simplified_calculation: For rate-latency service curve beta(t) = R*(t-T), delay = (burst + R*T) / R

equations_used.per_hop_delay: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_{M_i}^h, beta_{M_i}^h) = sup_{t>=0} { inf { tau >= 0 : alpha_{M_i}^h(t) <= beta_{M_i}^h(t + tau) } }
equations_used.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum(D_f^h for all hops) + hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay)

all_parameters_used.credit_upper_bound: c_max = 0 (no higher priority classes than AVB_A)
all_parameters_used.per_hop_delay_calculation: Network Calculus horizontal deviation between aggregate arrival curve and CBS service curve
all_parameters_used.aggregate_arrival_includes: all flows traversing the same egress port, shaped by link and CBS constraints

WCD_calculation.method: Network Calculus Total Flow Analysis with CBS
steps: 1. Compute arrival curve at source: alpha_f^h0(t) = l_f + (l_f/P_f)*t
2. For each hop, aggregate all flows at egress port considering link and CBS shaping
3. Compute CBS service curve: beta(t) = idleSlope * [t - c_max/idleSlope]^+ where c_max=0
4. Calculate per-hop delay as horizontal deviation: D = hDev(alpha_agg, beta)
5. Sum per-hop delays and add (hop_count * 2µs) for propagation and switching delays
WCD_calculation.note: Per-hop delays computed considering flow aggregation at each egress port with CBS shaping

per_hop_delay_formula.D_f_h: hDev(alpha_Mi_h, beta_Mi_h) = sup_t { inf { tau >= 0 : alpha(t) <= beta(t + tau) } }
per_hop_delay_formula.simplified: For rate-latency service curve beta(t) = R*[t-T]^+, delay = (burst / R) + T
per_hop_delay_formula.aggregate_burst_calculation: sum of all flow bursts at port
per_hop_delay_formula.aggregate_rate_calculation: sum of all flow rates at port

all_parameters_used.frame_overhead: Ethernet frame overhead included in payload
all_parameters_used.aggregate_method: sum all flows at each egress port

WCD_calculation.note: Queuing delay calculated using worst-case aggregate burst at each egress port divided by service rate

4. Apply CBS shaping: idleSlope = 75 Mbps, c_max = 0
5. Calculate per-hop delay using horizontal deviation: D = aggregate_burst / idleSlope
6. Sum delays across all hops plus fixed delays (2 µs per hop)
7. WCD = sum(per_hop_delays) + hop_count * 2

WCD_calculation.simplified_calculation: For each hop: D_h ≈ (aggregate_burst_at_port) / idleSlope + frame_transmission_time
WCD_calculation.aggregate_consideration: Multiple flows on same port increase aggregate burst, thus increasing delay

CBS_parameters_explanation.per_hop_delay_calculation: D = burst / idleSlope = l_max_bits / 75000000 bps, converted to microseconds
CBS_parameters_explanation.aggregate_arrival: Sum of all flow bursts and rates at each egress port, shaped by CBS and link constraints

WCD_calculation_method.description: Network Calculus Total Flow Analysis with CBS shaping
steps: 1. Calculate frame size (payload + 42 bytes overhead) and convert to bits
2. Determine arrival curve: burst = frame_size_bits, rate = frame_size_bits / period
3. For each egress port, aggregate all flows traversing it
4. Apply CBS shaping: idleSlope = 75 Mbps, sendSlope = -25 Mbps
5. Calculate credit bounds: c_min = -0.25 * l_max, c_max = 0
6. Derive service curve: beta(t) = 75e6 * t
7. Compute per-hop delay: D = hDev(alpha, beta) ≈ max_frame_bits / idleSlope
8. Sum delays across all hops plus propagation (1µs) and switching (1µs) per hop
9. Total WCD = sum(per_hop_delays) + hop_count * 2µs (prop + switch per hop)

equations_used.aggregate_arrival_curve: alpha_M_i^h(t) = sum over all flows in class M_i of min(alpha_f^{h-,h}(t), sigma_link^{h-,h}(t), sigma_CBS^{h-,h}(t))
equations_used.credit_upper_bound: c_max = 0 (no higher priority classes than AVB_A at PCP=6)
equations_used.credit_lower_bound: c_min = sendSlope * l_max / C = -25Mbps * l_max / 100Mbps = -0.25 * l_max
equations_used.per_hop_delay: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_M_i^h, beta_M_i^h) = sup_t { inf { tau >= 0 : alpha(t) <= beta(t+tau) } }
equations_used.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_f = sum(D_f^h for all hops) + hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay)

all_parameters_used.CBS_service_curve: beta(t) = 75,000,000 * t (rate-latency with zero latency since c_max=0)
all_parameters_used.per_hop_delay_formula: D = hDev(alpha, beta) = burst / idleSlope (simplified for single class)

cbs_parameters_derivation.credit_upper_bound_formula: c_{M_i}^{h,max} = 0 (no higher priority classes, no lower priority interference assumed)

where.l_f: frame_size = payload + 38 bytes (Ethernet overhead: preamble 8, header 14, CRC 4, IFG 12)

per_hop_delay_formula.equation: D_f^h = hDev(alpha_{M_i}^h, beta_{M_i}^h) = sup_{t>=0} { inf { tau >= 0 : alpha_{M_i}^h(t) <= beta_{M_i}^h(t + tau) } }
per_hop_delay_formula.aggregate_burst: b_{M_i}^h = sum of all bursts from flows in class M_i arriving at port h

end_to_end_wcd_formula.equation: WCD_f = sum_{h in path} D_f^h + hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay)

calculation_details.aggregate_consideration: All flows sharing egress ports contribute to aggregate arrival curve

all_parameters_used.aggregate_burst_calculation: sum of frame sizes of all flows sharing egress port

WCD_calculation.formula: WCD_f = sum(D_f^h for all hops h) + hop_count * (propagation_delay + switching_delay) + time_sync_error * number_of_switches
WCD_calculation.additional_sync_error: 1us per switch in path (included in fixed delay calculation)
WCD_calculation.note: Cut-through switching allows frame forwarding to begin before complete reception
